player_prompt.intro: Waxaad tahay ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ee ciyaarta wadahadalka. Waxaad haysataa xoogaa kheyraad ah, hawshaaduna waa inaad ganacsi sameyso si wadarta qiimaha kheyraadkaagu u kordho. Kheyraadka iyo qiimaha la xiriira ee aad hadda haysato waa: + {resource_value_list} Dhan kasta, waxaad la hadli kartaa qofka kaa soo horjeeda oo aad u sameyn kartaa dalab ganacsi. Isticmaal astaamaha gaarka ah ee soo socda ee ficillada: - '[Talo: 3 Adhi, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Talo: Kheyraadka la bixiyay -> Kheyraadka la codsaday] - '[Accept]': Si aad u aqbasho dalab soo galaya. - '[Deny]': Si aad u diiddo dalab soo galaya (default). Ciyaartu waxay socotaa {max_turns} wareeg oo dhan.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Ciyaaryahanka ayaa isku dayay inuu aqbalo ganacsi isaga oo aan haysan ilaha lagama maarmaanka ah.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id}, ficil aan ansax ahayn. Tiirka {col} waa ka baxsan yahay.
invalid_move.already_full: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id}, ficil aan ansax ahayn. Tiirka {col} waa buuxsan yahay.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} wuxuu isku dayay inuu sameeyo dalab ganacsi isagoo aan haysan ilaha loo baahan yahay.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} wuxuu sameeyay dalab ganacsi oo qaab qaldan ku qoran.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ma uusan sameynin wax dalab ganacsi oo cusub.

offers.accept: Ciyaaryahanka {acceptor_id} wuxuu aqbalay dalabka ganacsiga ee Ciyaaryahanka {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} wuxuu soo bandhigay dalabka soo socda ee Ciyaaryahanka {opponent_id}: Alaabada la bixiyay: {offered} -> Alaabada la codsaday: {requested}

outcome.win: Ciyaaryahanka {winner_id} wuxuu ku guuleystay isagoo leh faa'iido weyn oo ku saabsan qiimaha kaydka.
outcome.draw: Isbedelka qiimaha saamiga ee ciyaartoyda oo dhan waa isku mid.
